brief.aim: The table is a transaction log with no plausible outcome column, so the defensible task is unsupervised segmentation of its rows, keeping each customer's lines together and preserving invoice chronology.
brief.repeated_subjects: CustomerID repeats across many invoice lines and StockCode repeats across many invoices, so neither is unique per row.
brief.unit: one invoice line item (a single StockCode on a single InvoiceNo)
